drivers.driver: There were still many bargains even after the sharp rebound.
drivers.quote: I don't know what the averages are going to do next

drivers.driver: Purchase understandable businesses at low prices against net worth or going-concern value, with good management and resilience.
Patience and independent appraisal matter more than institutional pressure to act.
Ordinary recession and profit fears did not invalidate the available values at these prices.

entry_valuation_stated: Interview Dow ~580 then ~660, not verified November 1 close; prices low relative to business value.
outcome_note: Valuation-driven bullish stance, not a prediction of the next move in the averages.
